name: POS Direct Note
description: Add custom notes to products for seamless order management and improved customer service.  Notes appear on orders and receipts, ensuring clear communication and efficient service.
summary: The Product Notes Integration for Point of Sale app enhances your POS system by allowing users to seamlessly add customizable notes to individual products. These notes are automatically reflected in both the order and the customer receipt, ensuring that essential product details such as special instructions, warnings, or any other important information are always visible to both staff and customers. This easy-to-configure feature streamlines communication between team members, preventing mistakes and ensuring that customers receive the most accurate and complete information about their purchases. The app is designed to improve efficiency in retail and service environments by eliminating the need for manual note entry during transactions, saving valuable time and reducing errors. Whether you're handling special customer requests, offering product-specific warnings, or providing additional details on a product, the app ensures these notes are consistently visible at the point of sale. The automatic inclusion of product notes in receipts ensures customers are also kept in the loop, enhancing their experience with your business.
